formulations.name: Brahma Rasayana (First)
formulations.preparation_method: Five root pentads boiled in ten times water, reduced to one-tenth, filtered. Haritaki and amalaki fruits seeded and pounded, mixed into decoction with herb powders and sugarcandy. Tila oil and ghee cooked in copper utensil on mild fire until linctus consistency. Honey added after cooling. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel.
formulations.dosage: Dose that does not disturb digestion of food
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with milk after drug is digested

formulations.name: Brahma Rasayana (Second / Amalaka Brahma Rasayana)

ingredients.quantity: 1000 fruits steamed + juice of 1000 fresh fruits for impregnation

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaki fruits steamed on milk vapour, dried in shade, seeds removed and powdered. Powder impregnated 21 times with juice of 1000 fresh amalaki fruits. Herb powders added in 1/8 quantity. Impregnated with nagabala juice 40 kg and dried in shade. Ghee or ghee-honey added and shaped into boluses. Stored underground in ashes for fortnight after protective rites. After fortnight, metal bhasmas added in 1/8 quantity.
formulations.dosage: 5 gm gradually increasing daily in every morning according to power of digestion
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with milk added with ghee after drug is digested

formulations.name: Cyavanaprasa

ingredients.form: seeded, fried in tila oil and ghee

formulations.preparation_method: All herbs boiled in 100 litres 240 ml water till fully extracted. Decoction brought down. Amalaki fruits taken out, seeded, fried in tila oil and ghee 480 gm, cooked in above decoction with sugarcandy as linctus. After self-cooling, honey 240 gm added. Finally twak, ela, patra and nagakesara 160 gm added.
formulations.dosage: Dose which does not interfere with food intake and digestion

formulations.name: Amalaka Rasayana (Fourth - Triphala Baked)
formulations.preparation_method: Fruits wrapped in palasa bark, pasted with mud, cooked on charcoal. Seeds removed. Pounded in mortar with curd, ghee, honey, sesamum paste, tila oil and sugar. Taken on empty stomach. After course, patient normalised with gruel, massaged with ghee and barley powder.
formulations.dosage: As per power of digestion
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee along with soup or milk for double the treatment period

formulations.name: Haritaki Ghrita (Fifth Formulation of Haritaki)

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaka powder (impregnated 100 times with amalaka juice)

formulations.preparation_method: Ghee extracted from milk cooked with paste of listed herbs. Mixed with honey, sugar and amalaka powder (impregnated 100 times with amalaka juice) and iron bhasma in 1/4 quantity. Taken 10 gm every morning.
indications: life-span of hundred years free from old age
formulations.dosage: 10 gm every morning
formulations.anupana: Evening diet of sali and sastika rice with ghee along with soup of green gram or milk

formulations.name: Amalakaghrta

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaka juice (from good soil, mature fruits)

formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with amalaka juice and punarnava paste. Process repeated with vidari juice and jivanti paste. Then with four times milk and decoction of bala and atibala with shatavari paste. Process repeated hundred or thousand times. Sugar and honey added in 1/4 quantity. Kept in golden, silver or earthen pitcher uncted with ghee.
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion every morning
formulations.anupana: Sali or sastika rice with milk and ghee after drug digested

formulations.name: Amalakavaleha (First)

ingredients.form: dipped in alkaline water from palasa tree, dried, seeded, powdered
dipped in alkaline water, dried, seeded, powdered

formulations.preparation_method: Fruits dipped in alkaline water from palasa tree. Dried in shade, seeds removed and powdered. Powder mixed with four times honey, ghee and quarter sugar. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored underground for six months.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without old age
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion only in forenoon, not in afternoon

formulations.name: Amalaka-churna

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaki fruit powder (impregnated 21 days with amalaki juice)

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaki powder impregnated with amalaki juice for 21 days and nights. Mixed with honey, ghee, pippali and sugar. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored in early rains under heap of ashes. Used after rainy season is over.
indications: stable lifespan of one hundred years devoid of old age
formulations.dosage: According to suitable and wholesome diet

formulations.name: Vidangavaleha
formulations.preparation_method: All mixed together and kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored in early rains under heap of ashes.

formulations.name: Amalakavaleha (Second)

ingredients.form: heated in covered tub with cowdung fire, seeded, crushed

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaka fruits heated in covered tub of fresh palasa wood with cowdung fire. Cooled, seeds removed, crushed. Mixed with pippali powder, vidanga powder, sugar, oil, honey and ghee. Kept in clean strong vessel uncted with ghee for 21 days.
indications: life-span of hundred years devoid of old age

formulations.name: Nagabala Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Roots collected in cala muhurta in month of Magha or Phalguna from forest with specific soil conditions. Roots washed, bark taken 40 gm finely pounded. Used with milk every morning or as powder with milk or with honey and ghee.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without senility
formulations.dosage: 40 gm bark
formulations.anupana: Milk; or honey and ghee. After digestion: sali or sastika rice with milk and ghee.

formulations.name: Bala-Chandanadi Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Juice of listed drugs used by method as in nagabala. If fresh juice not available: drug dipped in equal water for 24 hours, pressed and filtered as svarasa.

formulations.name: Bhallataka-Ksira (Bhallataka with milk)

ingredients.quantity: 10 fruits increasing by 1 daily to 30, total 1000
ingredients.form: crushed, boiled in 10 times water to 1/8th extract

formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka fruits collected in month of Jyestha or Asadha, stored in barley/black gram granary for 4 months. After 4 months taken out. Starting with 10 fruits, crushed and boiled in 10 times water to 1/8th. Filtered, taken with milk. Mouth smeared with ghee before taking. Dose increased by 1 fruit per day to maximum 30. Total 1000 fruits. After treatment, milk diet for double the treatment period.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without senility
formulations.dosage: 10 fruits increasing by 1 daily up to 30, then decreasing
formulations.anupana: Sali or sastika rice with milk added with ghee. Milk diet after treatment for double period.
contraindications: must prepare body first with cold, unctuous and sweet substances

formulations.name: Bhallatakaksaudra (Bhallataka with honey)

ingredients.form: crushed, heated in vessel, extract collected

formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka fruits crushed, filled in heating vessel placed on firm uncted pitcher dug underground upto neck. Covered with lid, pasted with black earth, heated with cowdung fire. Extract collected in lower pitcher. Taken mixed with 1/8 honey and double ghee.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without old age

formulations.name: Bhallataka Taila (Bhallataka oil cooked with madhuka)
formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka taila cooked with milk and paste of madhuka in 1/8 quantity. Process repeated hundred times.

formulations.name: Aindra Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: All mixed together and used. After food is digested, diet with honey and plenty of ghee given.
formulations.anupana: Honey and plenty of ghee after food is digested

formulations.name: Intellect-Promoting Rasayana Drugs (Medhya Rasayana)
formulations.preparation_method: Each used separately: juice of mandukaparni; powder of yastimadhu with milk; juice of guduchi stem along with root and flowers; paste of shankhapushpi.

formulations.name: Pippali Rasayana (Simple)

ingredients.quantity: 5, 7, 8 or 10 fruits for one year; or 3 fruits thrice daily
ingredients.form: impregnated with palasa alkali, fried in ghee

formulations.preparation_method: Pippali fruits impregnated with alkali of palasa then fried in ghee. Taken with honey. Used for one year.
formulations.dosage: 5, 7, 8 or 10 fruits with honey and ghee; or 3 fruits thrice daily for one year

formulations.name: Pippali Vardhamana Rasayana (Graduated Pippali)

ingredients.form: paste / decoction / powder as per strength

formulations.preparation_method: Day 1: 10 pippali. Each day add 10 more until day 10 (100 total). From day 11, decrease by 10 daily back to 10 on day 19. High strength: paste; medium strength: decoction; low strength: powder.
formulations.dosage: 10 increasing to 100 over 10 days, then decreasing back to 10 over next 9 days
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk after drug digested

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana (First)
formulations.preparation_method: Taken with honey and ghee for one year in specified timing and quantities.
indications: hundred years free from old age and diseases
formulations.dosage: Haritaki 1 after digestion; Bibhitaka 2 after meals; Amalaki 4 after meals

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana (Iron Plate Method)
formulations.preparation_method: New iron plate plastered with triphala paste. After 24 hours paste collected and taken dissolved in honey water. Meals taken with plenty of fat. Observed for one year.
indications: hundred years devoid of senility and diseases
formulations.anupana: Meals with plenty of fat after drug digested

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana with Madhuka
formulations.preparation_method: Triphala mixed with madhuka, tugaksiri and pippali with honey and ghee.

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana with Metals

ingredients.herb_name: All six metals including gold (Suvarna, Rajata, Tamra, Loha, etc.)

formulations.preparation_method: Triphala with metals, vaca, vidanga and pippali or with lavana taken with honey and ghee for one year.

formulations.name: Silajatu Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Silajatu impregnated in lukewarm decoction of vata/pitta/kapha alleviating drugs by dipping and removing at end of day. Repeated for a week. Mixed with powdered metals and taken with milk.
formulations.dosage: 40 gm (superior), 20 gm (medium), 10 gm (inferior). Duration: 7 weeks (superior), 3 weeks (medium), 1 week (inferior)

formulations.name: Lauhadi Rasayana (Iron Rasayana)

ingredients.form: heated red-hot, dipped in decoction, powdered like collyrium

ingredients.herb_name: Alkali from lavana, ingudi and palasa

formulations.preparation_method: Iron pieces 4 fingers long heated red hot, dipped in decoction of triphala, cow urine and alkali till transformed like collyrium. Powdered finely. Mixed with honey and amalaka juice as linctus. Kept in ghee-uncted pitcher in barley granary for one year, stirred monthly. After one year, taken with honey and ghee every morning per strength with suitable diet.
indications: invincibility against injury, diseases, senility and death
formulations.dosage: According to strength, every morning

formulations.name: Amalakayasa Brahma Rasayana

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaki (hand-plucked fruits, dried, powdered, impregnated 21 times with amalaka juice)

formulations.preparation_method: All drugs boiled in ten times water to one-tenth decoction. Filtered and amalaka powder added. Heated on cowdung fire till liquid evaporated. Collected, dried on iron plates, powdered finely on deer-hide with stone slabs. Stored in iron vessel. Iron bhasma added in 1/4 quantity. Mixed with honey and ghee for use.
indications: strength of intellect and sense organs
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion

formulations.name: Broad-Spectrum Rasayana (Indra's Second Rasayana)
formulations.preparation_method: All juices cooked with cow-milk, tila oil and cow-ghee till fatty preparation. Brought down. Amalaka powder, honey, sugar, vamsalocana and pippali mixed in. Kept in earthen jar smeared with ghee for fortnight. Metal bhasmas in 1/16 quantity mixed before use.
indications: strength to psyche / memory / physique / agni / intellect / senses
formulations.dosage: According to digestion. Avoid exertion and sexual intercourse during medication.
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk

formulations.name: Sara-adi Bulk-Promoting Bolus (Vajikarana)
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs 120 gm each with black gram 2.56 kg cooked in 10.24 litres water to 1/4. Pastes of madhuka, draksa, phalgu, pippali, kapikacchi, madhika and shatavari added with juices and ghee 2.56 kg and milk 10.24 litres. Cooked till ghee remains. Filtered, sugar, vamsalocana, pippali, marica, twak, ela, nagakesara powders added. Honey 320 gm mixed in. Solid boluses of 40 gm prepared and fried in ghee.
formulations.dosage: 40 gm bolus according to digestive power

formulations.name: Aphrodisiac Ghee (Kapikacchi-Ashwagandha)
formulations.preparation_method: Black gram and kapikacchi boiled together to decoction with listed herbs. Ghee, cow-milk and juices added and cooked on mild fire until ghee remains. Sugar, vamsalocana, honey, pippali added to prepared ghee.
formulations.dosage: 40 gm before meals

formulations.name: Satavari Ghrita (Aphrodisiac)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee prepared with shatavari in ten times milk. Added with sugar, pippali and honey.

formulations.name: Madhuka Aphrodisiac Formulation
formulations.preparation_method: 10 gm madhuka powder mixed with ghee and honey, taken with milk.
formulations.dosage: 10 gm

formulations.name: Pippali Aphrodisiac (Thirty Pippali with milk)

ingredients.form: well-pounded, fried in tila oil and ghee

formulations.preparation_method: 30 pippali fried in tila oil and ghee 40 gm each, added with sugar and honey. Processed with milk stream according to strength. Taken with sastika rice diet and ghee extracted from milk.
indications: no diminution in stiffness of organs
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk

formulations.name: Kapikacchi-Shatavari Fertility Juice
formulations.preparation_method: Ingredients boiled in milk and water each 640 ml till 640 ml remains. Filtered with clean cloth. Sugar, vamsalocana and fresh ghee added. Mixed with honey before taking. Taken with boiled sastika rice.
indications: large progeny for even old and weak

formulations.name: Shatavari-Vidari Ghrita (Virility Ghee)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoctions prepared separately for each herb. Ghee cooked with eight times milk using these decoctions. Sugar and honey added.

formulations.name: Vidari Ghrita (Hundred Times Processed)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 2.56 kg cooked with vidari juice hundred times quantity. Then cooked again with hundred times cow-ghee. Final preparations of sugar, vamsalocana, honey, iksuraka, pippali and kapikacchi seeds added in 1/4 quantity. Made into boluses of udumbara fruit size.

formulations.name: Sastikadi Gutika (Fertility-Producing Bolus)

ingredients.herb_name: Kapikacchi seeds (decoction in black gram decoction)

formulations.preparation_method: Rice juice extracted with milk and cow-milk cooked with decoctions. Powders added to solidify. Honey, sugar added and boluses of jujube size prepared, fried in ghee.
indications: large progeny even in old age
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion

formulations.name: Evacuation Formulation (Pre-Rasayana Cleansing)
formulations.preparation_method: Powders of all ingredients combined and taken with hot water. After evacuation and routine dietetic regimen, barley preparation with ghee given for 3, 5 or 7 days.
